name: io.github.bernardTavares/bevox-hetzner-mcp
title: bevox-hetzner-mcp
description: Stdio bridge to a self-hosted bevox-hetzner-mcp daemon for governed Hetzner Cloud operations

environmentVariables.name: BEVOX_AGENT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Agent bearer token from the daemon's AGENT_CREDENTIALS

environmentVariables.name: BEVOX_REST_URL
environmentVariables.description: REST root of the self-hosted daemon

environmentVariables.name: BEVOX_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Cloudflare Access service-token client id, only if the daemon is behind Access

environmentVariables.name: BEVOX_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Cloudflare Access service-token secret, set together with the client id
